recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a detailed butterfly in flight against a warm, hazy gradient background, characterized by long trailing lines, a soft cast shadow, and aggressive, sharp-edged display typography contrasted with delicate vertical text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: The butterfly acts as the primary focal point, positioned in the upper right quadrant.
A soft, diffused shadow of the butterfly is cast onto the background, creating depth.
Long, thin white and brown lines trail from the butterfly, leading the eye to the bottom left.
Aggressive, jagged title text overlaps a softer, vertical subtitle block on the left.
coreInvariants: Butterfly with dark wings and iridescent blue/green highlights
Sharp, thorn-like letterforms for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The butterfly is medium-scale, placed in the top-right third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, dark butterfly provides the weight, while the vertical text blocks on the left balance the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the butterfly, follows the trailing white line downward in a curve, then moves up the left side through the vertical text to the sharp title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the center and bottom-right creates an airy, atmospheric feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and muted orange provide the atmospheric background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black in the butterfly wings and text shadows provide structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red-orange in the title and vertical bars; iridescent blue-green on the butterfly wings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and butterfly details against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except for butterfly highlights
No pure white except for the thin trailing line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif for vertical text; aggressive display for title.
letterConstructionRules: Title letters must have sharp, elongated vertical terminals resembling thorns or blades.
Vertical text must be lowercase, extremely condensed, and spaced widely between letters.
Vertical text is housed within semi-transparent rectangular color blocks.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'T' in the title feature exaggerated vertical spikes.
The ampersand is simplified and stylized to match the vertical text weight.

treatment.shadow: hard drop shadow in dark brown

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, sharp display type paired with calm, minimalist vertical sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive nature of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a warm ochre-to-orange gradient background with a soft airbrushed texture. Place a detailed butterfly with dark wings and blue-green highlights in the upper right. Add a soft, blurry shadow of the butterfly slightly below and to the right. Draw a thin, elegant white line trailing from the butterfly's body in a sweeping curve toward the bottom left. Include two vertical semi-transparent orange-to-red gradient bars on the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a sharp, jagged red-orange font at the top left, overlapping the bars. Place the secondary text vertically inside the bars using a condensed, dark-colored lowercase sans-serif with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the butterfly shadow soft and diffused?
Does the title text have sharp, thorn-like points?
Is the secondary text stacked vertically with wide spacing?

adjustableVariables: Length of the trailing white line
Opacity of the vertical text bars

mustAchieve: Balance between sharp and soft elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the butterfly shadow doesn't have hard edges.
Check that the red title text is legible against the orange background.
Verify the vertical text is perfectly aligned within the bars.
Confirm the trailing line feels organic and fluid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Airbrush Style + Sharp/Soft Typographic Contrast + Vertical Text Stacking
